title: Probe-Seq
author: Ryoji Amamoto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baeiibce
materials: Dissect retinas in HBSS at RT.
From the Recoverall RNA/DNA Isolation Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific AM1975), mix 100 µL of Digestion Buffer and 4 µL of protease for each sample.

steps.title: Tissue Dissociation
steps.instruction: Dissociate the retina into single cells using Papain Mix and mechanical trituration.

substeps.instruction: Place retina in a microcentrifuge tube and remove most of the HBSS.
Add 400 µL of pre-warmed Papain Mix.
Incubate for 7 minutes at 37 °C with no agitation.
Spin at 600xg for 2.5 minutes at RT.
Remove supernatant and add 1 mL of HBSS/FBS without agitation.
Spin at 600xg for 2.5 minutes at RT.
Remove supernatant and add 600 µL of DMEM/BSA.
Dissociate by triturating the tissue with a P1000 pipette (~15 times in/out pipetting).

steps.title: Cell Fixation and Permeabilization
steps.instruction: Fix and permeabilize the dissociated cells.

substeps.instruction: Transfer homogenate to a 5 mL polypropylene tube (Thermo Fisher Scientific cat. #14-959-11A), ensuring the cap is sealed by pushing in.
Spin at 600xg for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant and add 1 mL of 4% PFA; resuspend and incubate for 15 minutes at 4 °C with rocking.
Spin at 2000xg for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant and add 1 mL of Permeabilization Buffer; resuspend and incubate for 10 minutes at 4 °C with rocking.
Spin at 2000xg for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Probe Hybridization
steps.instruction: Hybridize the cells with the Probe Mix at elevated temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and add 500 µL of 40% wHyb; resuspend and incubate for at least 30 minutes at 43 °C in the oven.
Spin at 2000xg for 5 minutes at RT.
Remove supernatant and add 100 µL of pre-warmed (43 °C) Probe Mix; resuspend and incubate for at least 16 hours at 43 °C in the oven.
Add 500 µL of pre-warmed (43 °C) 40% wHyb, resuspend, and spin at 2000xg for 5 minutes at RT.
Remove supernatant and add 500 µL of pre-warmed (43 °C) 40% wHyb; resuspend and incubate for 15 minutes at 43 °C.
Spin at 2000xg for 5 minutes at RT.
Remove supernatant and add 1 mL of pre-warmed (43 °C) 2x SSC; resuspend and incubate for 5 minutes at 43 °C.
Spin at 2000xg for 5 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Fluorescent Labeling
steps.instruction: Label the hybridized probes with Fluorescent Oligo Mix.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant, resuspend, and add 500 µL of pre-warmed (37 °C) PBS.
Spin at 2000xg for 5 minutes at RT.
Remove supernatant and add 100 µL of pre-warmed (37 °C) Fluorescent Oligo Mix; resuspend and incubate for 10 minutes at 37 °C.
Add 500 µL of pre-warmed (37 °C) PBS, resuspend, and spin at 2000xg for 5 minutes at RT.
Remove supernatant and add 500 µL of pre-warmed (37 °C) PBS; resuspend and incubate for 5 minutes at 37 °C.
Spin at 2000xg for 5 minutes at RT.

steps.title: FACS Sorting
steps.instruction: Filter cells and use FACS to isolate the target population.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 500–1000 µL of PBS and keep on ice.
Filter and proceed to FACS.
Gate based on Hoechst histogram to ensure 2N nuclei (exclude 4N nuclei).
Gate using a 2D plot with appropriate wavelengths to identify the positive population (shifted relative to the diagonal negative population).
Sort isolated cells into 1% BSA/PBS and keep at 4 °C.

steps.title: RNA Extraction Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare sorted cells for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 3000xg for 7 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove as much supernatant as possible (typically ~40-50 µL remains).
Incubate at 50 °C for 3 hours (wrap lid with parafilm).
Optional: Store samples at -80 °C indefinitely or proceed immediately.

steps.title: RNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify RNA using a filter-based method and DNase treatment.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Isolation Additive/Ethanol mix (for 100 µL digest: 120 µL isolation + 275 µL 100% Ethanol; adjust for actual volume, usually ~140 µL).
Add Isolation/Ethanol Mix and pipette to mix.
Add mixture onto filter and spin at 10000xg for 30 seconds at RT.
Discard flow-through and wash with 700 µL of Wash 1; spin at 10000xg for 30 seconds at RT.
Discard flow-through and wash with 500 µL of Wash 2; spin at 10000xg for 30 seconds at RT.
Discard flow-through and spin at 10000xg for 30 seconds at RT.
Prepare DNase Mix (6 µL 10x DNase Buffer, 4 µL DNase, 50 µL UltraPure Water).
Add 60 µL of DNase Mix to the center of the cartridge, close cap, and incubate for 30 minutes at RT.
Add 700 µL of Wash 1, incubate 1 minute at RT, and spin at 10000xg for 30 seconds at RT.
Discard flow-through and wash twice with 500 µL of Wash 2.
Spin at 10000xg for 1 minute to remove residual fluid.

steps.title: RNA Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA and store or proceed to cDNA synthesis.

substeps.instruction: Elute in ~17 µL of UltraPure water (use more water for lower concentration; 17 µL yields ~12 µL of RNA).
Store RNA at -80 °C.
Optional: Estimate RNA concentration using Qubit or BioAnalyzer (may not work if <10,000 cells).
Proceed to SMART-Seq v.4 protocol: use 9.5 µL of RNA for cDNA synthesis and 150 pg of cDNA for Nextera XT library kit.
